elders.name: Council of elders
elders.desc: The oldest decide together. Fine for a band, slow for a nation.

chief.name: Chiefdom
chief.desc: One family rules. Strong while the chief is loved.

council.name: Council
council.desc: Heads of families vote. Stable, slow to go to war.

priestking.name: Priest-king
priestking.desc: The sky-speakers rule in the sky's name. Your omens weigh heavily.

warlord.name: Warlord
warlord.desc: Whoever holds the spears holds power. Quick to fight, quick to fall.
